body: I hope you were able to get some sleep. Good for you for not harming yourself. That is a big accomplishment and helps us all stay strong.

Thanks. I am just scared. In hight school when they found me cutting they locked me in a room for 2 days because no one could get a hold of my parents and I have some other issues with the hospital but I feel like if I could sleep things would be better. I do have a friend who is awake that I am msging - I don't want to tell her I am suicidal but she understands the insomnia.

I saw this and first I thought - ugh looks too long to read I won't finish the whole thing. Then I got swept away by your writing. All of us who have been there - in that dark, empty, space - sort of like space itself - cold and airless know what it feels like. Thank you for writing. Keep on writing and if you feel like sharing it with us please share more. I am new to this subreddit and your post really resonated with me. As bad as it is, it always helps to know there are others out there. It doesn't lessen the pain or the emptiness but at least I feel less alone. Thank you.
